edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — once she spends it she has no peel, and your engage kills her outright before Silver Bolts stacks.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Final Hour gives AD, speed and Tumble invisibility but no health at all — commit and your combo still kills straight through it.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver lands before her crit items — burst her while Condemn's 20s is running.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: It flips here: Silver Bolts takes a cut of your max health every third hit, and Final Hour's Tumble stealth breaks your target lock.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Condemn: 20s at rank 1 and her only peel — bait it on the clone and she is defenceless. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1 falling to 2s, so it is not the cooldown to wait on. - Cyclone: kill windows only.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s at rank 1. Bait it onto the clone, then walk in free.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Silver Bolts is percent max health true damage — armour will not save you.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Every wave she farms free buys the late game where her kiting beats you — deny the CS now, you will not out-duel her later.
